نتبصبص (form IIq)
# نَتَبَصْبَصُ (natabaṣbaṣu) /na.ta.basˤ.ba.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
# نَتَبَصْبَصَ (natabaṣbaṣa) /na.ta.basˤ.ba.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
# نَتَبَصْبَصْ (natabaṣbaṣ) /na.ta.basˤ.basˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
